verdict.rationale: The official docs show programmatic client usage (`client.runs.create(...)`, polling `runs.events()`), and the GitHub README directs developers to a Python library for automating the web from their own code. Together these point to first-party client libraries, but the pack never names an SDK package, its install steps, or supported languages. missing for 10: explicitly named official SDK packages and install instructions, supported-language coverage (e.g. Python/TypeScript), SDK reference docs, independent hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
